claim: On September 12, 2024 Amazon Cognito user pools added the ability to send multi-factor authentication (MFA) codes by email message, as part of advanced security features. Today MFA with email one-time codes is a feature of the Essentials and Plus feature plans.
question: Since when can Amazon Cognito user pools send MFA codes by email, and which feature plans include it today?

qualifiers.condition: at launch: with advanced security features; today: Essentials or Plus feature plan

evidence.quote: | [New advanced security features for email MFA.](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cognito/latest/developerguide/features-email-mfa.html) | You can now send multi-factor authentication (MFA) codes by email message with advanced security features. | September 12, 2024 |
| MFA with email one-time codes | Request or require local users to provide an additional email message sign-in factor after username authentication | Essentials \+ Plus |
